review.scope: Complete sewn polyester plush animal toys, including actual pattern/cut/sew, face attachment, stuffing, closure and whole-toy first release, with original-cohort services separately accounted.
review.source_and_method: Root read the actual complete Steiff manufacturing text, Tom product/material/safety/care context and Aurora staged inspections. The general glued cardboard-joint, sewn-eye and wood-wool/mohair routes differ from the genuine polyester plush/PES-fill Tom case; no common SKU/factory, eye polymer, washer or actual factory geography is invented. Manufacturer German legal address does not locate actual production. Tom historical sold-out status is preserved, not asserted current availability; dimensions/recycled share/certification/care limits are not factory defaults. Full actual EPA textile-fabrication selected context/figure and historical reporting limits remain distinct from LCA emissions, controls and zero claims. Upstream real fibre/textile finishing and all actual on-site processes remain complete. Ordinary measured quantities, specific auxiliary identities and actual site QA/provider qualification are unfinished study requirements; no identified intrinsic essential method gap has been waived.
review.native_and_classification: Whole state100 manufactured toy family includes stuffed animal figures; actual complete toy and polyester route fit the broad Product Mass/kg identity without using raw fibre or empty shell as core. Full native regenerated-fibre fabric-versus-staple wording remains a conditional actual supplied-state restriction. Actual official Chinese basenames, every reference/secondary property, kg/MJ/m3 conversions, utility geography, CAS, resource/emission direction and receiver-medium restrictions were independently checked; availability of a Flow does not approve a Process. Narrower38520 association excludes whole dolls and other materials/mechanisms outside this route.
review.event_stock_accounting: Complete original acceptance event/cohort fates, independent full wet stocks and gross legs versus attributable exchange/service vectors, own inherited history once, whole actual Qt and compatible nonoverlapping A/Q0 reviewed. No allocated physical receiver mass, extra component exports or duplicate providers.
review.bilingual: Scoped complete EN/ZH critical conditions and actual typed/literal/context/source/protocol/measurement/calculation/quality/inventory consistency reviewed; no scientific or empirical factory qualification.
review.remaining_limits: Actual measured configured quantities, real complete matched providers and source/matrix/dependency/site QA remain study obligations. Unestablished essential actual procedures stay holds; ordinary unresolved identities never become zeros/proxies.
